title: Will Florida Georgia Line Make a Return to Stagecoach? Watch a New Video Teaser
summary: New video shows FGL's Brian Kelley & Tyler Hubbard together and seems to strongly hint at a Stagecoach return.
contentText:
Could Florida Georgia Line be making a return to the massive Stagecoach Country Music Festival?

The duo’s official Instagram account, as well as Stagecoach’s account, seem to be hinting that the duo could be returning to the revered festival.

On Sept. 10, a video posted on both accounts showed clips of previous FGL performances and then featured FGL’s Tyler Hubbard and Brian Kelley slamming a truck tailgate shut (with a cooler emblazoned with Stagecoach’s horse image) before getting into the truck together.

Kelley asks Hubbard, “Are we really doing this again?” before Hubbard responds, “It looks like it. Let’s go!” and together they ride the truck off into the sunset.

The post was captioned with “LFG,” while Kelley also commented on the post, writing, “AMPED LFG,” and Hubbard responded to his comment, writing, “LETS GOOO” Meanwhile, Hubbard’s wife Hayley also commented on the post, writing, “Let’s run it back!”

Notably, FGL’s managers , The Core Entertainment’s Simon Tikhman and Chief Zaruk, both commented positively on the post, with Chief commenting, “LFG!!!! Family is back!!” with a heart and fire emoji, and Tikhman commenting, “We are so back.”

FGL last headlined Stagecoach in 2018, when they joined Garth Brooks and Keith Urban as headliners. They also played the fest in 2013 and 2014.

Stagecoach is set to take place April 23-25, 2027, in Indio, California.

In June, FGL reunited for a brief performance during CMA Fest in Nashville and had previously teamed up during Country Radio Seminar to help honor Jason Aldean. The reunion performances come after FGL split in 2022 over differing views regarding how to balance the duo’s music, with each member pursuing solo careers. Both Hubbard and Kelley ended up releasing multiple solo projects, before they began spending more time together last fall and earlier this year, with Kelley  posting  a video from a hike the duo took together in January.

Only time will tell if they in fact will return to the desert country music fest. In the meantime, see the Instagram Reel below:
